steps: Open an owned completed project under LLM_PROVIDER=mock.
Locate the Chinese follow-up prompt in the workbench left rail and submit a follow-up that changes a visible mock marker.
Wait for the incremental run to complete.
expect: An incremental iteration run starts from the UI and a new version/preview reflects the change.
Follow-up send is disabled while the run is active.

steps: With network request logging enabled, visit `/`, an owned `/projects/[projectId]`, and a `/share/[shareSlug]`.
Collect all request URLs during load and idle.
expect: No request host matches esm.sh, unpkg, jsdelivr, cdn.tailwindcss.com, fonts.googleapis.com, or fonts.gstatic.com.

steps: Open a public share URL without the owner deviceId cookie.
Inspect the left rail / controls for follow-up, share mutation, and ZIP owner actions.
expect: Follow-up send is absent or disabled.
No owner mutation controls are actionable.

steps: Open the 预览 tab and toggle `移动 375px`.
Read the preview iframe sandbox attribute.
expect: Mobile frame constrains preview width near 375px.

steps: Switch preview/code/version tabs and expand a timeline card while a run pulse would normally animate.
expect: Decorative tab/timeline/running-pulse animations do not continue under reduced motion.

steps: Force or select replay provider mode after a Gemini-style failure path under mock/replay wiring.
Inspect workbench banners and qa_rounds metadata including the 3-round cap path.
expect: `演示回放` banner is visible when replay fallback is active.
`已达修复上限` appears when qa_rounds hits the exhaustion cap.

steps: Complete a mock follow-up that updates qa_rounds / version state.
Hard refresh the workbench in the same device context.
expect: Persisted qa_rounds and version/preview state remain accurate after reload.
Follow-up input remains available when no run is active.

steps: From home at 1280×800, keyboard-tab to the prompt submit control, open a project, then tab to follow-up, timeline expanders, preview width toggle, and preview/code/version tabs.
Repeat a responsive spot-check at 375×812 for card clipping and page overflow.
expect: Focus-visible rings appear on primary controls and all listed controls are reachable by keyboard.
Zero horizontal page overflow and zero clipped 我的项目 card text at both viewports.
